tools.name: about
tools.description: Free: describes this server's paid tools and pricing.

tools.name: generate_stl
tools.description: Generate a 3D-printable STL from a text prompt: cookie cutter, stamp, or jewelry. Costs $0.15 (USDC, Base). Returns STL file as a base64 resource plus JSON metadata.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Web search across multiple engines (Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, Brave). Costs $0.01 (USDC, Base). Returns JSON results: title, url, snippet, engine.

tools.name: web_search_read
tools.description: Web search plus the full plain-text content of the top results in one call. Costs $0.02 (USDC, Base). Returns JSON: url, title, text per page.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "generate_stl" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
